title: Silent and Costly: Characterizing and Detecting Prompt-Caching Mis-Integration in LLM Agents
title_zh: 无声而代价高昂：LLM智能体中提示缓存的错误集成表征与检测

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) services process massive volumes of user requests, resulting in substantial inference costs. To reduce both cost and latency, providers have introduced prompt caching. However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial due to heterogeneous provider-specific APIs and continuously evolving caching semantics. To understand prompt-caching mis-integration in downstream applications, we conduct the first empirical study of 120 prompt-caching-related pull requests from 10 popular open-source agent systems. Our findings show that prompt-caching mis-integrations arise in both request-side misconfiguration and read-side usage miscount. More importantly, most mis-integrations fail silently without causing observable runtime failures.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）服务需要处理海量用户请求，导致高昂的推理成本。 为了同时降低成本与延迟，服务提供商引入了提示词缓存。 然而，由于各服务提供商的API各不相同且缓存语义持续演变，正确集成提示词缓存并非易事。 为了理解下游应用中提示词缓存的错误集成问题，我们对来自10个热门开源智能体系统的120个与提示词缓存相关的拉取请求开展了首个实证研究。 我们的发现表明，提示词缓存的错误集成既出现在请求侧的配置错误中，也出现在读取侧的使用计数错误中。 更重要的是，大多数错误集成会静默失败，不会引发可观察的运行时故障。

paragraphs.en: Motivated by these findings, we design CacheLint , which models a prompt-caching mis-integration as an invocation site together with the preconditions required for correct cache integration. CacheLint locates caching invocation sites with CodeQL and discharges each precondition either against a dated provider-capability oracle or with an LLM guard check. CacheLint achieves 0.71 precision and 0.78 recall in identifying the 120 labeled mis-integrations across the 10 studied agent systems. Our evaluation further demonstrates the effectiveness of CacheLint in real-world settings, identifying 32 mis-integrations across 571 agent projects with 0.86 precision. These findings have received 21 developer confirmations and led to 18 upstream fixes, including one in Anthropic’s official SDK.

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) services process billions of requests from end users every day, incurring considerable inference costs [ 1 ] . Prior work [ 2 ] shows that a substantial fraction of prompts are identical, such as system prompts and few-shot examples used in multi-turn conversations. When such prompts are decomposed into multiple requests to LLM services, the same prefix is repeatedly sent across requests. Consequently, LLMs repeatedly reprocess these identical prompt portions, leading to redundant computation and substantial token costs. By mid-2025, enterprise-level LLM API costs were estimated to have reached $8.4 billion [ 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）服务每天处理来自终端用户的数十亿条请求，产生了相当可观的推理成本 [ 1 ]。 已有工作 [ 2 ] 表明，相当大一部分提示词是完全相同的，例如多轮对话中使用的系统提示词和少样本示例。 当此类提示词被拆分为发往 LLM 服务的多个请求时，相同的前缀会在各请求间被反复发送。 因此，LLM 会反复重新处理这些相同的提示词部分，导致冗余计算和可观的 token 成本。 到 2025 年年中，企业级 LLM API 成本估计已达 84 亿美元 [ 3 ]。

paragraphs.en: To address this inefficiency, LLM providers have introduced prompt caching [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , which reduces redundant computation over identical prompt prefixes by reusing previously computed intermediate results. Specifically, user prompts are cached based on their token prefixes; a cache hit occurs when the incoming request shares an exact token-prefix match with a previously cached prompt, starting from the first token (i.e., byte-for-byte equality). In this case, the cached computation is reused instead of recomputing the prefix. Otherwise, a cache miss occurs, and the prompt is processed normally while its prefix may be inserted into the cache for future reuse. Any modification, insertion, or reordering invalidates the match from that point onward [ 4 , 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一低效问题，大语言模型提供商引入了提示缓存 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]，通过复用先前计算的中间结果，减少对相同提示前缀的冗余计算。 具体而言，用户提示基于其 token 前缀进行缓存；当传入的请求与先前缓存的提示从第一个 token 开始（即逐字节相等）具有完全相同的 token 前缀匹配时，就会发生缓存命中。 在这种情况下，缓存的计算会被复用，而无需重新计算该前缀。 否则，会发生缓存未命中，提示将被正常处理，同时其前缀可能会被插入缓存以供将来复用。 任何修改、插入或重排都会使从该点开始的匹配失效 [ 4 , 7 ]。

paragraphs.en: However, correctly integrating prompt caching is non-trivial because provider-specific configuration settings vary and the underlying mechanisms evolve. For example, Anthropic [ 4 ] and Amazon Bedrock [ 8 ] require applications to explicitly opt into caching and enforce limits on the number of cache entries per request, whereas OpenAI and Gemini apply caching automatically [ 5 , 6 ] . Different providers adopt different caching enablement settings. Moreover, providers’ prompt caching semantics can evolve over time. For instance, Bedrock introduced an opt-in one-hour cache lifetime tied to specific models [ 9 ] , while Anthropic later reduced the default cache duration from one hour to five minutes, which significantly affected hit rates in unchanged deployments [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，正确集成提示缓存并非易事，因为各提供商特有的配置设置各不相同，且底层机制也在不断演进。 例如，Anthropic [ 4 ] 和 Amazon Bedrock [ 8 ] 要求应用显式选择启用缓存，并对每次请求的缓存条目数量施加限制，而 OpenAI 和 Gemini 则自动应用缓存 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 不同提供商采用不同的缓存启用设置。 此外，各提供商的提示缓存语义可能随时间演变。 例如，Bedrock 引入了与特定模型绑定的可选一小时缓存生命周期 [ 9 ] ，而 Anthropic 随后把默认缓存时长从一小时缩短为五分钟，这显著影响了未做任何更改的部署中的命中率 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing studies have investigated prompt defects and prompt caching performance, but have overlooked the integration issues of prompt caching from the application side. For instance, several existing studies [ 11 , 12 , 13 ] investigate software defects that degrade the performance and reliability of LLM-integrated systems, including inference engines or agent orchestration frameworks. They do not consider prompt caching a distinct source of integration defects. Later, Tian et al. [ 14 ] identified prompt caching as a literature-derived subtype of performance and efficiency defects in a prompt defect taxonomy, while Lumer et al. [ 15 ] evaluated prompt caching strategies for reducing latency and API cost. Neither of these studies investigates prompt cache misses caused by application-level integration.

paragraphs.en: Our study uncovers three key findings. First, prompt caching integration defects are concentrated on the request side. Of the 120 defects, 97 corrupt outgoing requests, while the remaining 23 preserve requests but misparse cache-usage metrics. Interestingly, we find that the heterogeneous provider-specific caching mechanisms account for 47 request-side defects, while inconsistent application-side specification of prompt prefixes (e.g., system prompts) is another major cause of cache misses. Second, prompt-caching mis-integration is often silent. In 108 mis-integration cases, defects produce no errors because the model recomputes outputs without using cached tokens. The resulting cache misses manifest only as increased cost and latency in usage metrics. Third, the mis-integration fixes are typically small and localized to request-construction code. These findings suggest that prompt-caching mis-integrations often preserve functional outputs and evade dynamic test oracles, making static analysis a well-suited detection approach.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究揭示了三项关键发现。 首先，提示缓存集成缺陷集中在请求侧。 在120个缺陷中，97个会破坏外发请求，其余23个虽保留请求但错误解析缓存使用指标。 有趣的是，我们发现异构的服务商特定缓存机制导致了47个请求侧缺陷，而应用侧对提示前缀（如系统提示）定义不一致则是缓存未命中的另一个主要原因。 其次，提示缓存集成错误往往是静默的。 在108个集成错误案例中，缺陷不产生任何错误，因为模型会在不使用缓存令牌的情况下重新计算输出。 由此产生的缓存未命中仅表现为使用指标中成本和延迟的增加。 第三，集成错误的修复通常规模很小，且局限于请求构造代码。 这些发现表明，提示缓存集成错误通常会保持功能输出不变并规避动态测试判定器，因此静态分析是一种非常适合的检测方法。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we develop CacheLint , a static analysis technique for detecting prompt-caching mis-integrations in agent applications. As shown in Fig. 1 , CacheLint pairs each prompt-caching invocation site with its required preconditions, derived from the fixing patterns of our empirical study. Given an agent application codebase, CacheLint uses CodeQL [ 16 ] to identify prompt-caching API invocation sites and extract their surrounding code context. It then checks each associated precondition by either comparing provider-capability preconditions against a dated capability oracle or prompting an LLM ( gpt-5.4-mini ) with the invocation-site context to assess prefix-stability and accounting preconditions. When a precondition check fails, CacheLint reports the corresponding invocation site and suggests a fix.

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching is an optimization technique that reduces LLM inference cost and latency by reusing the computation of previously processed prompt prefixes. Specifically, when a new prompt begins with a prefix that exactly matches a cached prefix, the provider reuses the cached computation instead of recomputing the prefix and charges cached tokens at a substantially reduced rate [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 提示词缓存是一种优化技术，通过复用先前已处理的提示词前缀的计算结果，来降低大语言模型（LLM）推理的成本和延迟。 具体而言，当一个新的提示词以与缓存前缀完全匹配的前缀开头时，提供商会复用缓存中的计算结果，而无需重新计算该前缀，并对缓存的令牌按大幅降低的费率收费 [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching is effective for LLM agents because of frequent prompt reuse. In each call, the agent constructs a prompt from a stable preamble, typically a system instruction, tool definitions, and retrieved or environment context, followed by the conversation history [ 18 ] . Across consecutive calls, these prompts share a long common prefix, while only the latest user message or model response changes. Without prompt caching, the agent repeatedly transmits and the LLM repeatedly processes thousands of identical prompt tokens. By reusing these stable prefixes, prompt caching can reduce cached input costs to roughly one-tenth of the standard price and decrease inference latency by up to 80% [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 1 ] . Consequently, modern agent frameworks are increasingly designed to maximize cache reuse [ 19 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 提示词缓存对智能体（agents）非常有效，因为提示词会被频繁复用。 在每次调用中，智能体构建的提示词由一个稳定的前导部分组成，通常是系统指令、工具定义以及检索到的或环境上下文，其后是对话历史 [ 18 ]。 在连续调用之间，这些提示词共享一段很长的公共前缀，只有最新的用户消息或模型回复会发生变化。 若没有提示词缓存，智能体需要反复传输，而大语言模型需要反复处理数千个相同的提示词词元。 通过复用这些稳定的前缀，提示词缓存可以将缓存输入的成本降至标准价格的大约十分之一，并将推理延迟降低至多 80% [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 1 ]。 因此，现代智能体框架在设计上日益注重最大化缓存复用 [ 19 ]。

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching integration refers to how applications construct and configure prompts to satisfy provider-defined requirements for enabling caching behavior. When correctly integrated, prompt caching enables reuse of previously computed prompt prefixes, resulting in cache hits; otherwise, the system falls back to full recomputation.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词缓存集成是指应用程序如何构建和配置提示词，以满足服务商定义的启用缓存行为的要求。 当正确集成时，提示词缓存可以复用先前已计算的提示词前缀，从而产生缓存命中；否则，系统将回退到完整重新计算。

paragraphs.en: The correct integration of prompt caching places two requirements on applications. First, the application must maintain prefix stability. As providers perform byte-level matching from the first token, the prompt prefix must exactly match a previously cached prefix to guarantee cache hits. Even minor modifications to the prefix can invalidate cache reuse from that point onward [ 4 , 5 , 7 ] . Second, the application must correctly configure provider-exposed caching parameters. For example, settings such as cache prefix length and cache lifetime determine whether a request is eligible for caching and whether cached entries can be reused. Insufficient prefix length or short cache windows may prevent reuse of previously computed results, leading to cache misses even when prompts are structurally identical.
paragraphs.zh: 正确集成提示缓存对应用程序提出了两项要求。 首先，应用程序必须保持前缀稳定性。 由于服务商从首个 token 开始进行字节级匹配，提示前缀必须与之前缓存的前缀完全一致，才能保证缓存命中。 即使对前缀的微小修改也可能使从该点开始的缓存复用失效 [ 4 , 5 , 7 ] 。 其次，应用程序必须正确配置服务商暴露的缓存参数。 例如，缓存前缀长度和缓存生存期等设置决定了请求是否有资格被缓存，以及缓存条目能否被复用。 前缀长度不足或缓存时间窗口过短可能导致之前计算的结果无法复用，即使提示在结构上完全相同，也会导致缓存未命中。

paragraphs.en: The developer attempted to enable the agent to answer queries about the current time while benefiting from prompt caching. The original implementation prepends datetime.now().isoformat() to the system prompt. Since cache hits require an exact match of the prompt prefix from the first token, the changing timestamp invalidates cache reuse for all subsequent stable content (left side of Fig. 2 ). As a result, despite the provider correctly implementing prompt caching, the application fails to reuse cached prompt prefixes and repeatedly recomputes the stable guidelines and retrieved context. Additionally, because the agent continues to produce correct outputs without raising any errors, this mis-integration remains silent until increased inference cost or a reduced cache-hit rate is observed.
paragraphs.zh: 开发者试图让智能体能够回答关于当前时间的查询，同时享受提示词缓存带来的好处。 原始实现将 datetime.now().isoformat() 前置到系统提示词中。 由于缓存命中要求从第一个词元开始对提示词前缀进行精确匹配，不断变化的时间戳使所有后续稳定内容（图 2 左侧）的缓存复用失效。 结果是，尽管服务提供商正确实现了提示词缓存，该应用却无法复用已缓存的提示词前缀，并反复重新计算稳定的准则与检索到的上下文。 此外，由于智能体持续产生正确的输出而没有引发任何错误，这种错误的集成方式一直处于潜伏状态，直到推理成本增加或缓存命中率下降才被发现。

paragraphs.en: To address this issue, the developer coarsens the timestamp to date granularity using .date() , which enables the prompt prefix to remain stable throughout the day while still providing accurate time information (right side of Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，开发者使用 .date() 将时间戳粗化为日期粒度，这使得提示前缀在一天之内保持稳定，同时仍能提供准确的时间信息（图 2 右侧）。

paragraphs.en: We define such prompt-caching mis-integration as application code that violates provider requirements for enabling, configuring, or accounting for prompt caching. Such defects can prevent cache reuse, cause incorrect cache accounting, or even trigger runtime failures. Despite their practical impact, real-world reports show that many of these defects remain unnoticed in production until operational metrics, such as cache-hit rates or API costs, are examined [ 7 , 22 ] . This gap motivates our empirical study and the development of automated detection of prompt-caching mis-integration.

paragraphs.en: Request-side mis-integration occurs when an agent constructs or configures a request incorrectly, causing the provider to recompute content that could otherwise be served from the cache, thereby incurring the full inference cost, or causing the request to fail at runtime.

paragraphs.en: Provider compatibility. The agent adds a provider-specific caching configuration that is unsupported by the selected model or provider, causing the provider to ignore the configuration and leave prompt caching inactive. Two root causes account for this failure.
paragraphs.zh: 提供商兼容性。 智能体添加了所选模型或提供商不支持的特定于提供商的缓存配置，导致提供商忽略该配置，使提示词缓存保持未启用状态。 两个根本原因导致了这一故障。

sents.en: Provider compatibility.
sents.zh: 提供商兼容性。

sents.en: The agent adds a provider-specific caching configuration that is unsupported by the selected model or provider, causing the provider to ignore the configuration and leave prompt caching inactive.
sents.zh: 智能体添加了所选模型或提供商不支持的特定于提供商的缓存配置，导致提供商忽略该配置，使提示词缓存保持未启用状态。

sents.en: Two root causes account for this failure.
sents.zh: 两个根本原因导致了这一故障。

paragraphs.en: First, model-name gating enables caching based on hardcoded model identifiers rather than provider capabilities. As a result, a model rename or the addition of a new model can silently disable caching. Listing shows a model-name-based mis-integration in cline#3343 . Specifically, an upstream rename changed a Gemini 2.5 model ID, but the application enabled caching only for models whose names began with claude or contained anthropic . As a result, the renamed model no longer passed the check, and caching was disabled. Similar failures occurred in OpenHands#8365 , where a -latest tag was removed; hermes-agent#17425 , which excluded MiniMax’s cacheable models; and OpenHands#4704 , where an overly restrictive condition disabled caching altogether. Second, an incompatible marker occurs when the agent attaches a provider-specific caching marker that the selected provider or model does not support. For example, nanobot#2687 attached Anthropic cache_control markers to requests for every model accessed through OpenRouter. Because GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek models do not support this marker, the requests resulted in 401 errors and a runtime crash.

paragraphs.en: Prefix stability. The agent’s own prefix is not stable from one call to the next, so it never matches the prefix the previous call cached. Four root causes destabilize the prefix. A volatile value embeds a per-request datum in the cached span: as shown in Listing , goose#2434 placed a live timestamp in the cached system prompt, changing the prefix on every call so the cache never hit. Similarly, nanobot#1115 did the same with a minute-level clock, and in each case the fix moves the volatile datum out of the cached span. Prefix reassembly rebuilds the prefix in a changed order or shape each call, as in hermes-agent#754 , where a gateway reassembled the system prompt every turn and lifted cost by roughly 75%. Nondeterministic serialization emits different bytes for identical content, as in openclaw#64198 ’s per-instance map order and hermes-agent#3991 ’s random uuid4 call-id. A misplaced marker sits on a changing message rather than on the stable prefix.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀稳定性。 智能体自身的前缀在多次调用之间并不稳定，因此永远无法命中上一次调用所缓存的前缀。 四个根本原因会破坏前缀的稳定性。 易变值在缓存区间中嵌入了每次请求的数据：如清单所示，goose#2434 在缓存的系统提示词中放置了一个实时时间戳，导致每次调用的前缀都发生变化，缓存永远无法命中。 类似地，nanobot#1115 用分钟级时钟犯了同样的错误，而在这两个案例中，修复方法都是把易变数据移出缓存区间。 前缀重组在每次调用时以变化的顺序或形状重建前缀，例如 hermes-agent#754，其中一个网关每一轮都重新组装系统提示词，使成本上升了约 75%。 非确定性序列化对相同内容输出不同的字节，例如 openclaw#64198 的按实例变化的映射顺序，以及 hermes-agent#3991 的随机 uuid4 调用 ID。 位置错误的标记放在了不断变化的消息上，而不是稳定的前缀上。

sents.en: Prefix stability.
sents.zh: 前缀稳定性。

sents.en: The agent’s own prefix is not stable from one call to the next, so it never matches the prefix the previous call cached.
sents.zh: 智能体自身的前缀在多次调用之间并不稳定，因此永远无法命中上一次调用所缓存的前缀。

sents.en: Four root causes destabilize the prefix.
sents.zh: 四个根本原因会破坏前缀的稳定性。

sents.en: A volatile value embeds a per-request datum in the cached span: as shown in Listing , goose#2434 placed a live timestamp in the cached system prompt, changing the prefix on every call so the cache never hit.
sents.zh: 易变值在缓存区间中嵌入了每次请求的数据：如清单所示，goose#2434 在缓存的系统提示词中放置了一个实时时间戳，导致每次调用的前缀都发生变化，缓存永远无法命中。

sents.en: Similarly, nanobot#1115 did the same with a minute-level clock, and in each case the fix moves the volatile datum out of the cached span.
sents.zh: 类似地，nanobot#1115 用分钟级时钟犯了同样的错误，而在这两个案例中，修复方法都是把易变数据移出缓存区间。

sents.en: Prefix reassembly rebuilds the prefix in a changed order or shape each call, as in hermes-agent#754 , where a gateway reassembled the system prompt every turn and lifted cost by roughly 75%.
sents.zh: 前缀重组在每次调用时以变化的顺序或形状重建前缀，例如 hermes-agent#754，其中一个网关每一轮都重新组装系统提示词，使成本上升了约 75%。

sents.en: Nondeterministic serialization emits different bytes for identical content, as in openclaw#64198 ’s per-instance map order and hermes-agent#3991 ’s random uuid4 call-id.
sents.zh: 非确定性序列化对相同内容输出不同的字节，例如 openclaw#64198 的按实例变化的映射顺序，以及 hermes-agent#3991 的随机 uuid4 调用 ID。

sents.en: A misplaced marker sits on a changing message rather than on the stable prefix.
sents.zh: 位置错误的标记放在了不断变化的消息上，而不是稳定的前缀上。

paragraphs.en: Cross-turn mutation. A cross-turn mutation lets a stateful change between turns rewrite a fragment an earlier turn had already cached, so the next call writes the cache again instead of reading it. In openclaw#58038 , pruning history images after three turns rewrote the already-cached conversation prefix mid-session, so each compaction silently rebuilt the cache instead of hitting it.
paragraphs.zh: 跨轮次变更。 跨轮次变更指的是轮次之间的有状态更改会重写前一轮次已经缓存的内容片段，导致下一次调用重新写入缓存，而不是读取缓存。 在 openclaw#58038 中，三轮之后裁剪历史图片会在会话中途重写已经缓存的前缀，因此每次压缩都在静默地重建缓存，而不是命中缓存。

paragraphs.en: Read-side mis-integrations occur when caching works exactly as intended, but the agent mishandles the cache usage the provider reports back in the response.
paragraphs.zh: 当缓存完全按预期工作时，智能体却错误地处理了提供商在响应中报告的缓存使用情况，这时就会发生读取端的错误集成。

paragraphs.en: Usage miscount. The provider reports cache usage in its response, but the agent incorrectly parses, aggregates, prices, or displays the returned cache-token counts. In cline#10266 , the cache-creation tokens were hardcoded to zero in two provider handlers, so the usage readout reported no caching even as the cache kept hitting.
paragraphs.zh: 用量统计错误。 服务商在响应中报告了缓存用量，但智能体对返回的缓存令牌数量进行解析、汇总、计价或展示时出错。 在 cline#10266 中，两个服务商处理器将缓存创建令牌硬编码为零，导致用量读数显示没有任何缓存命中，而实际上缓存一直在命中。

paragraphs.en: Table II shows that 108 of the 120 defects (90%) remain silent. They raise no exception, no failed assertion, and no crash, and the model output stays correct while only caching degrades. We discuss the symptoms below.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 显示，120 个缺陷中有 108 个（90%）保持静默。 它们不会引发任何异常、任何失败的断言或崩溃，模型输出保持正确，而只有缓存发生退化。 我们在下面讨论这些症状。

sents.en: They raise no exception, no failed assertion, and no crash, and the model output stays correct while only caching degrades.
sents.zh: 它们不会引发任何异常、任何失败的断言或崩溃，模型输出保持正确，而只有缓存发生退化。

sents.en: We discuss the symptoms below.
sents.zh: 我们在下面讨论这些症状。

paragraphs.en: Within these no-error defects, the vast majority, 86 (72%), are silent waste: the cache stops hitting and the run continues unchanged, so the only trace is extra spend on a hosted API or added latency on the application, visible only on a usage meter. cline#3343 is typical, where a renamed model slipped past a caching gate and the bill climbed with no other sign. The remaining 22 (18%) of the no-error defects produce wrong telemetry: caching works as intended, but the cache-token counts reported to the developer are parsed, summed, or displayed incorrectly, so the meter a developer would trust to confirm caching is itself wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些无报错缺陷中，绝大多数，即86例（占72%），是静默浪费：缓存停止命中而运行照常继续，唯一的痕迹是托管API上的额外开销或应用上的延迟增加，只能在使用量计费表上看到。cline#3343就是典型例子：一个被改名的模型绕过了缓存判定关卡，账单不断攀升却没有其他任何迹象。 其余22例（占18%）无报错缺陷会产生错误的遥测数据：缓存本身按预期工作，但报告给开发者的缓存令牌计数在解析、求和或显示时出错，因此开发者本用来确认缓存生效的计费表本身就是错的。

paragraphs.en: Only 12 of the 120 defects (10%) crash, and they concentrate in incompatible markers (8 of the 12); the other four are cross-turn mutations (2), a misplaced marker (1), and a usage miscount (1). A crash is the one symptom an ordinary oracle catches, because it surfaces as an explicit error the first time the request runs: OpenHands#3689 hit Vertex’s Extra inputs not permitted rejection on a cache_control field, hermes-agent#1216 drew a 400 from a cache marker on an empty text block, and AutoGPT#12789 raised a TypeError on a null cache-token field. A single run or test exposes each, whereas the other 90% give no such signal.
paragraphs.zh: 120 个缺陷中只有 12 个（10%）会导致崩溃，且它们集中在不兼容的标记上（12 个中有 8 个）；其余四个是跨轮次变更（2 个）、标记位置错误（1 个）和使用计数错误（1 个）。 崩溃是普通判定标准能捕获的唯一症状，因为它会在请求首次运行时以显式错误的形式出现：OpenHands#3689 在 cache_control 字段上触发了 Vertex 的「Extra inputs not permitted」拒绝，hermes-agent#1216 在空文本块上的缓存标记收到了 400 错误，AutoGPT#12789 在为空的缓存令牌字段上抛出了 TypeError。 单次运行或测试即可暴露每一个这类缺陷，而其余 90% 的缺陷则不会给出任何此类信号。

paragraphs.en: In summary, detecting prompt-caching mis-integration is hard precisely because 90% of the defects fail silently: cline#3343 let a renamed model slip past a caching gate while the bill simply climbed, goose#2434 placed a live timestamp in the system prompt so the cache never hit, and cline#10266 hardcoded cache-creation tokens to zero so even the usage meter under-reported caching. None of them raises an exception or changes the model’s answer, so crash- and assertion-based oracles miss the majority by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，检测提示缓存（prompt-caching）集成错误之所以困难，正是因为 90% 的缺陷都以静默方式失败：cline#3343 让一个被重命名的模型绕过了缓存判定，而账单却在悄悄攀升；goose#2434 在系统提示中放置了一个实时更新的时间戳，导致缓存永远无法命中；cline#10266 将缓存创建 token 硬编码为零，以至于连用量统计都低估了缓存的使用。 它们都不会抛出异常，也不会改变模型的回答，因此基于崩溃和断言的判定方法在结构上注定会漏掉大多数缺陷。

paragraphs.en: We studied the 120 merged fixes together with the discussion in their linked reports to explore (1) the common patterns and (2) the complexity of the fixing patches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了这 120 个合并的修复及其关联报告中的讨论，以探索 (1) 修复补丁的常见模式以及 (2) 修复补丁的复杂性。

paragraphs.en: Common fixing patterns. As shown in Fig. 3 , the eight root causes map to six recurring fixing strategies. Each strategy involves a relatively small, localized repair. Capability lookup resolves caching from a provider-capability check instead of a hardcoded model name; the marker guard attaches the cache marker only in the shape and on the message the provider accepts; a cache-boundary fix moves changing content out of the cached span (or rebuilds that span in a fixed order) so the prefix stays byte-identical; prefix canonicalization serializes the prefix deterministically, e.g., by sorting map keys, so identical content always produces identical bytes; a lifecycle guard stops a later turn from rewriting a prefix an earlier turn already cached; and a usage-counter fix corrects the arithmetic that parses, sums, or displays the returned cache-token counts.
paragraphs.zh: 常见的修复模式。 如图 3 所示，八类根因对应六种反复出现的修复策略。 每种策略都只涉及较小的局部修复。 能力查找把缓存解析改为基于提供商能力检查，而不是硬编码的模型名称；标记守卫只在提供商接受的形态和消息上附加缓存标记；缓存边界修复把变化的内容移出被缓存的区间（或以固定顺序重建该区间），使前缀保持字节级一致；前缀规范化以确定性的方式序列化前缀，例如对映射键排序，使相同内容始终产生相同字节；生命周期守卫阻止后续轮次改写先前轮次已缓存的前缀；用量计数修复纠正解析、汇总或展示返回的缓存令牌计数的算术逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Fixing strategies are largely predictable from the underlying root causes. Simply assigning each root cause its most common fixing strategy correctly predicts 95 of the 120 fixes (79%), with U ⁡ ( fix ∣ rc ) = 0.72 U(\mathrm{fix}\mid\mathrm{rc})=0.72 . Five causes map to one strategy every time: usage miscounts to usage-counter fixes (23/23), volatile value to cache-boundary fixes (13/13), serialization to prefix canonicalization (10/10), cross-turn mutation to lifecycle guards (9/9), and misplaced markers to a marker guard (3/3). Only three cross-cutting causes spread their repairs: model-name gating splits between a capability lookup (21 of 37) and a marker guard (13), with a lifecycle guard (2) and prefix canonicalization (1) for the rest; an incompatible marker fans across four strategies, mostly a marker guard (6) with prefix canonicalization (2) and one each to a capability lookup and a lifecycle guard; and prefix reassembly divides among cache-boundary fixes (10), lifecycle guards (3), and prefix canonicalization (2). These three account for all 25 modal-fix errors, so the fix is largely, though not perfectly, a relabeling of the cause.
paragraphs.zh: 修复策略在很大程度上可以从其根本原因预测出来。 仅仅把每种根本原因分配给它最常见的修复策略，就能正确预测 120 个修复中的 95 个（79%），其中 U ⁡ ( fix ∣ rc ) = 0.72 U(\mathrm{fix}\mid\mathrm{rc})=0.72 。 有五种原因每次都映射到同一种策略：用量错误对应用量计数器修复（23/23），易变值对应缓存边界修复（13/13），序列化对应前缀规范化（10/10），跨轮次变更对应生命周期防护（9/9），标记错置对应标记防护（3/3）。 只有三种交叉性的原因会分散其修复方式：模型名称门控在能力查询（37 个中的 21 个）和标记防护（13 个）之间分配，其余为生命周期防护（2 个）和前缀规范化（1 个）；不兼容标记分散在四种策略上，主要是标记防护（6 个），其次是前缀规范化（2 个），能力查询和生命周期防护各 1 个；而前缀重组则分布在缓存边界修复（10 个）、生命周期防护（3 个）和前缀规范化（2 个）之间。 这三种原因涵盖了全部 25 个模态修复错误，因此修复在很大程度上（尽管不完美）就是对原因的重新标注。

paragraphs.en: Patch complexity. Although the strategy varies by cause, the patches themselves are small. Four of the six strategies are static, local, or report-only: capability lookups (22, 18%), marker guards (22, 18%), prefix canonicalization (15, 13%), and report-only usage-counter fixes (23, 19%), and together they cover 82 of the 120 fixes (68%); only cache-boundary fixes (23, 19%) and lifecycle guards (15, 13%) reach into runtime structure. The most common fix simply adds or corrects a single guard or the arithmetic on already-correct token counts.

paragraphs.en: Based on our empirical findings, we develop CacheLint , an automated technique for detecting prompt-caching mis-integrations in agent codebases. CacheLint models both prompt-caching-related APIs and the integration contexts associated with each class of mis-integration. Given an agent codebase, it performs static analysis to identify and report prompt-caching mis-integrations. We first present the underlying integration model and then describe the detection workflow.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 takes an application’s source, the implemented pairs, and the dated capability oracle O O , and emits a warning for each unguarded invocation. For each pair it locates the invocation sites of the marker or meter, and for each site it discharges the pair’s conjunct in one of two ways. A cap conjunct is settled off the program: CacheLint extracts the code’s capability assumption ⟨ site , provider scope , capability , predicate ⟩ \langle\textit{site},\textit{provider\ scope},\textit{capability},\textit{predicate}\rangle and diffs it against O O , a dated external lookup the model never performs. A stab or acct conjunct is settled on the program: CacheLint extracts the invocation site’s surrounding context and asks an LLM whether a discharging barrier reaches m m , such as a date-truncation or sort_keys canonicalizer for stab or an or 0 or accumulator guard for acct . This LLM guard check replaces the inter-procedural backward slice a static detector would use, which is brittle under the dynamic dispatch and reflection common in agent code. When no barrier discharges the conjunct, CacheLint emits the site, the verdict, and a suggested patch class drawn from RQ3’s cause-to-fix map (a capability lookup for model-name gating, a cache-boundary fix for a volatile value, a usage-counter fix for a usage miscount), so every warning ships with the modal repair developers already apply.

sents.en: When no barrier discharges the conjunct, CacheLint emits the site, the verdict, and a suggested patch class drawn from RQ3’s cause-to-fix map (a capability lookup for model-name gating, a cache-boundary fix for a volatile value, a usage-counter fix for a usage miscount), so every warning ships with the modal repair developers already apply.
sents.zh: 当没有屏障解除该合取项时，CacheLint 会输出该调用点、判定结果以及从 RQ3 的成因到修复映射中得出的建议补丁类别（针对模型名称门控的能力查询、针对易变值的缓存边界修复、针对使用量误计的使用计数修复），因此每条警告都附带开发者已经采用的主流修复方式。

paragraphs.en: For each cap assumption, CacheLint diffs the code’s predicate against a provider-capability matrix carrying an explicit last_verified date and a sourced behavior for each provider on an unsupported directive ( reject , ignore , or unknown ). When the code treats a model as capable but the matrix does not (an over-claim), the verdict is a hard bug if the provider rejects the directive, suspected if its behavior is unknown, and benign if it silently ignores it; when the matrix marks the model as capable but the code excludes it (an under-claim), the verdict is a silent latent miss. Because the matrix is dated and external, the same one-hour-TTL code shape resolves to a bug on Bedrock and an ok on the Anthropic API, a distinction no static rule makes (Section VII-B ). Provider changes therefore reach CacheLint through two places: this matrix, and the marker list K K and usage-field list U U that the CodeQL queries behind Locate match. Every matrix entry is sourced from the provider’s official documentation and stamped with the date of that check; when a provider changes its caching behavior, we update the affected entries and re-run CacheLint , leaving the CodeQL queries and the guard-check prompts unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个能力假设，CacheLint 将代码中的谓词与一个提供商能力矩阵进行比对，该矩阵为每个提供商携带明确的 last_verified 日期，并针对不支持的指令记录了有来源依据的行为（reject、ignore 或 unknown）。 当代码认为某个模型具备该能力而矩阵认为不具备（过度声明）时，若提供商拒绝该指令，则判定为硬缺陷；若其行为未知，则判定为疑似缺陷；若其静默忽略该指令，则判定为良性问题。而当矩阵将模型标记为具备能力但代码却将其排除在外（声明不足）时，判定为静默的潜在遗漏。 由于该矩阵带有日期且独立于代码之外，同样的 TTL 为一小时的代码形态在 Bedrock 上被判定为缺陷，而在 Anthropic API 上被判定为正常——这一区别是任何静态规则都无法做出的（第 VII-B 节）。 因此，提供商的变更通过两个途径进入 CacheLint：一是这个矩阵，二是 Locate 背后的 CodeQL 查询所匹配的标记列表 K 与用量字段列表 U。 矩阵中的每一项均来源于提供商的官方文档，并标注了核查日期；当提供商更改其缓存行为时，我们会更新受影响的条目并重新运行 CacheLint，而 CodeQL 查询与守卫检查提示词保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Datasets. We evaluate CacheLint on two datasets, both drawn from the 581 repositories collected in Section IV-A . Dataset A consists of the 10 agent applications from which we derived our detection model, together with the 120 mis-integrations labeled in them. Every defect in Dataset A is linked to a merged fixing PR, so the dataset provides ground truth and supports measuring both precision and recall. Because the detection rules were mined from these same fixes, the recall measured on Dataset A is an in-sample upper bound rather than an independent estimate. Dataset B consists of the remaining 571 repositories. It is disjoint from Dataset A, and therefore held out from rule derivation, and it is also broader, since it retains the agent SDKs, frameworks, and single-purpose tools that the empirical study excluded. No exhaustive defect labels exist for these repositories. We apply CacheLint to the latest version of every repository in both datasets and manually inspect each warning in its source context to label it a true or false positive.

paragraphs.en: Effectiveness on Dataset A. On Dataset A, CacheLint reports 132 potential mis-integrations, comprising 94 TP and 38 FP, and fails to report 26 of the 120 labeled defects. It thus achieves a precision of 0.71 and a recall of 0.78.

paragraphs.en: We manually inspected the code associated with the missed defects. We found that most false negatives stem from defects that require reasoning across multiple invocation sites or turns, which are beyond the scope of the single-site model in CacheLint . Of the 120 labeled defects, 96 occur at a single deterministic program point and are amenable to static inspection. These include model-name gating, usage miscounts, volatile cached-prefix values, nondeterministic serialization, misplaced markers, and incompatible markers. The remaining 24 defects require comparing prompts across calls or turns. They account for 24 of the 26 false negatives (15 involving prefix reassembly and 9 involving cross-turn mutation). The other two false negatives are in-scope volatile-value defects in which the changing values are introduced outside the enclosing function and thus fall beyond the context inspected by the guard check. Within its stated scope, CacheLint recovers 94 of the 96 in-scope defects, demonstrating near-complete coverage of defects amenable to single-site analysis.

paragraphs.en: Two examples illustrate the results. In dirac , prompt caching was gated on a hard-coded Claude model in a switch statement, the same pattern as in our motivating cline example. The maintainers later merged a capability-based fix. In n8n , a millisecond timestamp was prepended to the cached system prompt, causing the prefix to change on every request and preventing cache hits. These results show that CacheLint can detect prompt-caching mis-integrations in both large and widely used agent projects.

paragraphs.en: The five false positives match the syntactic pattern of a mis-integration but are benign. Two occur because the caching requirement has already been satisfied: in litellm , cache-token accounting is safely guarded with .get(…, 0) , and in unsloth , the system prompt uses a day-level date().isoformat() , which is stable enough for caching. In gemini-cli , a Date.now() value is used only as a request identifier and never appears in the cached prompt prefix. The remaining two arise from conservative matching: tldraw uses a provider feature flag that resembles model-name gating, and pydantic-ai contains a hard-coded model name only in test code. These cases are outside the scope of the current static rules and could be eliminated with more precise path-sensitive analysis.

paragraphs.en: CacheLint uses two procedures to discharge caching preconditions in Algorithm 1 . A cap conjunct is checked against the dated capability oracle, while stab and acct conjuncts are checked by the LLM-based guard check. To measure the contribution of each procedure, we construct two ablated variants and run them on Dataset B. Each ablated variant removes one component and falls back to gpt-5.4-mini without the context that the component provides. CacheLint w/o guard check judges every located stab or acct site with a generic API-misuse prompt instead of the targeted barrier question, for example whether a date() truncation or a sort_keys canonicalizer reaches the site. CacheLint w/o oracle judges every located cap site from the LLM’s own knowledge. Table III reports the results.
paragraphs.zh: CacheLint 使用两个流程来消解算法 1 中的缓存前置条件。 cap 合取项通过与带日期的能力预言机进行核对来检查，而 stab 和 acct 合取项则由基于 LLM 的护栏检查进行检查。 为了衡量每个流程的贡献，我们构建了两个消融变体并在数据集 B 上运行。 每个消融变体移除一个组件，并回退到不提供该组件上下文的 gpt-5.4-mini。 CacheLint w/o guard check 使用通用的 API 误用提示而不是针对性的屏障问题来判定每个定位到的 stab 或 acct 位置，例如 date() 截断或 sort_keys 规范化器是否会到达该位置。 CacheLint w/o oracle 仅凭 LLM 自身的知识来判定每个定位到的 cap 位置。 表 III 报告了结果。

paragraphs.en: The guard check is necessary for filtering benign stab and acct sites. Without it, precision drops from 0.86 to 0.31 because the detector reports many candidates whose caching preconditions have already been satisfied. For example, unsloth includes a timestamp in the system prompt, but the timestamp is coarsened to day granularity with date().isoformat() , making it stable enough for caching. The full CacheLint recognizes this guard and does not report the site, whereas CacheLint w/o guard check flags it as a volatile-value defect. Similarly, litellm safely accounts for cache tokens by guarding the lookup with .get(…, 0) before summing the values; the ablated variant reports this benign site.
paragraphs.zh: 该守卫检查对于过滤良性的 stab 和 acct 站点是必要的。 没有它，精确率会从 0.86 降到 0.31，因为检测器会报告许多缓存前置条件已经满足的候选站点。 例如，unsloth 在系统提示中包含一个时间戳，但该时间戳通过 date().isoformat() 被粗化为天级粒度，使其足够稳定以支持缓存。 完整的 CacheLint 能识别该守卫并不报告该站点，而去掉守卫检查的 CacheLint 则会将其标记为易变值缺陷。 同样，litellm 通过在求和之前用 .get(…, 0) 守卫查找来安全地统计缓存令牌；消融变体则会报告这个良性站点。

paragraphs.en: The dated capability oracle is also necessary. Without it, the model-name-gating query reports 349 candidate sites across the scanned repositories, most of which are benign branches in routers, registries, and tests. Precision drops to 0.05. The oracle distinguishes an actual capability mismatch from a harmless model gate. In dirac , for example, the oracle marks a renamed model as cacheable, while the code predicate excludes it; this disagreement exposes a real defect. In contrast, when a gated-out model is truly not cacheable, the code agrees with the oracle and the site is cleared. The oracle is also needed because these facts are time-sensitive: when asked about the 33 dated one-hour-TTL capability facts encoded in the matrix, gpt-5.4-mini answers only five confidently and correctly, and must abstain on models released after its training cutoff.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the practical value of CacheLint , we reported the 32 true-positive findings from RQ4 to project maintainers and tracked their responses. At the time of writing, 21 reports have been confirmed and 18 have been fixed; 11 are awaiting a response and none has been rejected. The confirmations include widely used projects such as AutoGPT , n8n , and Zed . The confirmed cases span provider SDKs, large frameworks, and single-maintainer tools. We discuss three representative examples.

paragraphs.en: Usage miscount in the Anthropic SDK. anthropic-sdk-csharp is Anthropic’s official .NET SDK. The API returns cache-creation and cache-read token counts as optional usage fields, but the SDK deserialized these fields into nullable properties and consumed them without a null check. When a response omits the fields, clients cannot reliably account for cache usage or cache savings. We reported the issue, and the maintainers fixed it.
paragraphs.zh: Anthropic SDK 中的用量计数错误。anthropic-sdk-csharp 是 Anthropic 的官方 .NET SDK。 API 将缓存创建和缓存读取的 token 计数作为可选的用量字段返回，但 SDK 将这些字段反序列化为可空属性，并在未做空值检查的情况下直接使用。 当响应省略这些字段时，客户端无法可靠地统计缓存使用量或缓存节省量。 我们报告了该问题，维护者已将其修复。

paragraphs.en: Model gating in altimate-code . altimate-code attached cache_control markers only for Anthropic-native calls, using a hard-coded set of model paths. Identical requests routed through OpenRouter- or Bedrock-style gateways were therefore left unmarked and could not use prompt caching. This is the same request-side gating pattern as in the motivating cline case. We reported the issue, and the maintainers fixed it by replacing the model-list check with a capability-based check.
paragraphs.zh: altimate-code 中的模型门控问题。altimate-code 仅在使用一组硬编码的模型路径时，才在 Anthropic 原生调用上附加 cache_control 标记。 因此，经由 OpenRouter 或 Bedrock 风格网关路由的相同请求不会被附加标记，也无法使用提示缓存。 这与此前激发本研究的 cline 案例中的请求侧门控模式相同。 我们报告了该问题，维护者随后通过将模型列表检查替换为基于能力的检查修复了它。

paragraphs.en: Volatile prefix in iTerm2 . iTerm2 is a widely used macOS terminal. Its assistant integration placed a request-varying value near the beginning of the cached system prompt. This changed the cached prefix on every call and prevented cache hits. We reported the issue, and the maintainer fixed it by moving the volatile value out of the cached region.
paragraphs.zh: iTerm2 中的易变前缀。iTerm2 是一款广泛使用的 macOS 终端。 其智能体集成在缓存的系统提示词的开头附近放置了一个随请求变化的值。 这导致每次调用时缓存前缀都发生变化，从而无法实现缓存命中。 我们报告了该问题，维护者通过将易变值移出缓存区域修复了此问题。

paragraphs.en: Construct and internal validity. Our results depend on how defects are identified, labeled, and validated. To reduce noise from keyword search, three authors independently screened all candidate PRs and identified 120 genuine prompt-caching defects. Three experienced raters also independently coded all defects and resolved disagreements by consensus. To reduce evaluation bias, we inspected each CacheLint warning in source context and reported findings upstream, where maintainers confirmed 21 reports and fixed 18. LLM judgments and provider capabilities may change over time. We mitigate this by fixing the prompts and model version, using a dated capability snapshot, and evaluating on 571 repositories. Recall on the 571 repositories is not measured because the total number of prompt-caching defects there is unknown; the 0.78 recall on the labeled corpus is an in-sample proxy, since the same corpus informed the detection rules.

paragraphs.en: External validity. Our taxonomy is derived from the ten most-starred multi-provider agent applications on GitHub and may not generalize to closed-source or non-GitHub projects. We mitigate this by evaluating CacheLint on 571 disjoint real-world repositories. CacheLint covers 96 ( 80 % 80\% ) of the defects in our dataset; multi-snapshot defects remain out of scope. The empirical study was restricted to end-user agent applications and excluded SDKs and frameworks, which may bias the taxonomy toward application code; however, the 571-repository evaluation set includes SDKs, and the confirmed defect in Anthropic’s official .NET SDK (Section VII-C ) shows that the same patterns occur in provider-maintained code. CacheLint targets mis-integrations that involve explicit cache markers or parameters, including OpenAI’s prompt_cache_key and Gemini’s cachedContent . When a provider enables caching automatically on the model side, request-side defects are observable only through the response, for example as consistently zero cached tokens; such implicit caching is outside CacheLint ’s current scope and is left for future work. As provider caching semantics evolve, our results reflect the 2026-05-10 capability snapshot. The taxonomy is separated from provider-specific API details; as caching APIs evolve, the oracle entries and detection rules are updated from providers’ published documentation, as described in Section VI-B .

paragraphs.en: Compatibility, fragmentation, and API misuse. Provider-specific caching behavior is related to platform compatibility and API-misuse research. FicFinder detects Android compatibility issues through API-context pairs [ 34 , 35 ] , while CiD studies API evolution [ 36 ] . Prompt caching introduces an additional dimension: application-side request invariants such as prefix stability and cache-marker accounting. Like API-misuse detectors [ 37 ] , CacheLint checks whether program behavior satisfies an external API contract. Rather than relying on usage patterns alone, it combines data-flow analysis with provider knowledge. Prompt-caching mis-integration also resembles a configuration error. Studies of misconfiguration show that such errors can cause production failures and often arise from unchecked assumptions about the deployment environment or software version [ 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 ] . Model-name gates and cache-marker shapes are assumptions of this kind, written into code rather than into configuration files, and CacheLint checks them against a dated external oracle.

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching and LLM serving. Prior systems optimize prompt caching inside the serving engine through KV-cache management [ 50 ] , cross-request prefix reuse [ 51 ] , and modular prompt reuse [ 2 ] . We instead study failures introduced by application code, where unstable prefixes or unsupported cache markers violate the engine’s caching preconditions before a request reaches the provider. Closer to our topic, Tian et al. [ 14 ] list prompt caching as one category in a taxonomy of prompt defects, and Lumer et al. [ 15 ] measure how caching strategies trade off cost against latency on long-horizon agentic tasks. Both treat caching as a defect category to catalog or as a strategy to tune; we instead characterize the defects that arise when applications integrate caching incorrectly and build a detector that flags them in code.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we presented the first empirical study of prompt-caching mis-integrations in LLM agent applications. We investigated 120 real defects from 10 open-source agent systems to characterize their root causes, symptoms, and fixes. We found that these defects arise on both the request and read sides, mostly fail silently while preserving model output, and are typically repaired by small, localized edits. Guided by these findings, we proposed a prompt-caching integration model that pairs each caching invocation site with the preconditions for its correct use, and built CacheLint , a static analysis technique that discharges each precondition against a dated provider-capability oracle or an LLM guard check. On 571 real-world repositories, CacheLint detected 32 previously unknown mis-integrations at 0.86 precision, yielding 21 developer confirmations and 18 upstream fixes. In the future, we plan to extend CacheLint ’s oracle to more providers and to automatically generate and validate fixes.
